description: This file defines and registers default templates for the CKEditor rich text editor, specifying how to insert predefined HTML snippets, images, and styles into the editor content.

methods.name: addTemplates
methods.description: Registers a new set of templates under a specified name in CKEditor.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for a given resource based on CKEditor's configuration.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Retrieves the path for a specified plugin within CKEditor.
